findings.claim: A small calibrated spatial stencil reconstructs fixed withheld water pixels more accurately than unweighted local averaging on this daily map.
findings.equation: T_hat=b0+b1 Hx+b2 Hy+b3 Ox+b4 Oy+b5 D, with fixed axial inner/outer means and diagonal mean.
findings.evidence: 23 reserved geographic tiles: MAE0.03284degreeC versus0.05750 local mean; worst tile0.06714 versus0.2450degreeC.
findings.known_prior_art: Spatial interpolation and high-order stencils are established numerical methods.
findings.falsification: Same-map neighbors are explicit calibration; this does not predict an unobserved date.
findings.scope: Valid-water complete neighborhoods within60degrees latitude; fixed sparse target lattice.

findings.claim: Accounting for spherical distance and local curvature is useful for this map reconstruction problem.
findings.equation: Spherical weighting H=(Hx+cos²(latitude)Hy)/(1+cos²(latitude)); a learned two-scale curvature correction is preserved.
findings.evidence: Fixed distance weighting MAE0.05037degreeC; curvature-plus-latitude candidate0.03459, compared with0.05750 unweighted local mean. The flexible stencil remains the frozen reference.
findings.known_prior_art: Geographic metric corrections and Taylor-error cancellation are known techniques, not new ocean laws.
findings.falsification: Directional fronts, coast exclusion and upstream satellite processing limit interpretation.
findings.scope: One processed global map; dependent pixels and geographic tiles.

findings.claim: These interpolation results demonstrate a new climate law, future thermal stress forecast or coral bleaching threshold.
findings.evidence: One date contains no temporal response; no bleaching observations or causal intervention are provided.
findings.known_prior_art: NOAA distinguishes this standard anomaly product from its coral bleaching heat-stress suite.
findings.falsification: Required independent endpoint and temporal evidence are absent.

scientific_adjudication: Agent-assisted analysis; not independent experimental replication or human expert adjudication.
